question: The average weight of Salil, Mukund and Sachin is 45 kg. If the average weight of Salil and Mukund is 44 kg and that of Mukund and Sachin is 48 kg, then the weight of Mukund (in kg) is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Weight of **Mukund** = (Sum of two pairs) − (Total Sum of three)

Weight = [(44 × 2) + (48 × 2)] − (45 × 3)

Weight = [88 + 96] − 135

Weight = 184 − 135 = 49 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 49 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Average weight of **Salil, Mukund, and Sachin** = 45 kg

Average weight of **Salil and Mukund** = 44 kg

Average weight of **Mukund and Sachin** = 48 kg

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/db89e648b7a347fe9e3acf3f0f46eaffe2a28a406b82d9cad92976d73d53de13.png] 

**Formula Used:**

Total Sum = Average × Number of entities

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total weight of Salil + Mukund + Sachin = 45 × 3 = 135 kg --- (i)

⇒ Weight of Salil + Mukund = 44 × 2 = 88 kg --- (ii)

⇒ Weight of Mukund + Sachin = 48 × 2 = 96 kg --- (iii)

⇒ Adding (ii) and (iii): Salil + (2 × Mukund) + Sachin = 88 + 96 = 184 kg

⇒ (Salil + Mukund + Sachin) + Mukund = 184 kg

⇒ 135 + Mukund = 184

⇒ Mukund = 184 − 135

⇒ Mukund = 49 kg

**∴ The correct answer is 49 kg.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Basic Average Formula

The average of n numbers is the sum of those numbers divided by n. Average = (Sum of observations) ÷ (Total number of observations).

Finding Overlapping Values

In problems where groups overlap (like A+B and B+C), the middle value (B) is found by: (Sum of Group 1 + Sum of Group 2) − (Total Sum of A+B+C).

Weighted Average

When two groups with different averages are combined, the new average = (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂) ÷ (n₁ + n₂).</p
